identity.holdout_purpose: qualification-held-out only. These inputs must not be used for screening, prompt tuning, routing calibration, few-shot selection, or any inspection that could shape a candidate.
identity.membership_encoding: one row per shard binding (product_family, family, size, split, record_count, sha256, shard filename)
identity.membership_list_of_case_ids_stored_reaso: the shard table byte-pins each shard and the verifier reads (product_family, family, size, split) back out of every record, so a separate 240-entry id list would be a second source of truth with nothing extra to say
identity.screening_split_location: the v1 pool, benchmarks/starter.jsonl, which this freeze declares as a contaminating foreign corpus
identity.cross_split_policy: no held-out input may share a case id, record digest, model-visible payload digest, rendered prompt digest or normalised template with any record of any other partition, including any split of the v1 pool

notes.mapping_discipline: one product family maps to exactly one dataset family. Folding several dataset families into one product family would let a strong sub-family mask a weak one inside a single qualification cell.
